## Wave 2 — verified ✅

The verifier approved all four fixes with high confidence (inspected on fetched `origin/main` in both submodules, not local pins):

| Issue | PR | Verified |
|---|---|---|
| [#2161](https://github.com/intent-hq/monorepo/issues/2161) | [fe#1134](https://github.com/intent-hq/cloudlands-fe/pull/1134) | Guarded virtual path (>20 flat rows, delegations/coordinator excluded), VirtualList wired, guard tests |

| [#2050](https://github.com/intent-hq/monorepo/issues/2050) | [intentd#1191](https://github.com/intent-hq/intentd/pull/1191) | Persist + stash before terminal events on both remaining paths, ordering tests |

All four issues closed and assigned to panghy; task notes marked complete.

**One deviation**: the typing task passed at completion time, but 6 issues filed *this afternoon* (#2247, #2248, #2270, #2274, #2275, #2276 — including our own follow-up #2247) are untyped again. Zero-untyped is a point-in-time invariant that will keep drifting as new issues are filed.

**Score so far**: 8 of the original 13 issues fixed and closed across two waves; all 13 typed; remaining are Wave 3 (#2127, #2098, #2063, #2122) and user-owned #417.

I've asked two questions above: how to handle the typing drift, and which parts of Wave 3 to start.
